content.text: I changed one file, `solution/core.py`, and the visible suite now passes (3 of 3). The bug was an off-by-one error: `parse_range` expanded each `a-b` token with `range(a, b)`, but Python's `range` stops before its end value, so every range lost its last number. That one cause explains all three failures: `1-3` gave 1–2, `7-9` gave 7–8, `-3--1` dropped -1, and `-2-1` dropped 1. The fix is to use `range(a, b + 1)` so both ends are included. The negative-number parsing, sorting, removing duplicates and error checks were already correct and I left them alone. I also ran a few cases outside the tests: `5-5` returns `[5]`, spaces around tokens and dashes still parse, and an empty string returns `[]`.
